findings.issue: The pinned LF Git blob is hashed from raw checkout bytes without an LF checkout rule. With core.autocrlf=true, the untouched report has CRLF and every gate invocation fails before evaluating any persona.

child.kill('SIGTERM') forcibly terminates Windows children instead of running their JavaScript signal handler. Requiring exit code 0 therefore makes the gate and npm test fail on a healthy Windows installation.

The no-echo probe scans only createInterface calls in youtube-auth.js, which now delegates to readHiddenLine and contains no such calls. A regression that echoes input in hidden-input.js is silently reported as passing.

summary: Fixed three gate defects: pinned-audit CRLF checkout failures, Windows SIGTERM false failures, and the vacuous passphrase no-echo probe. All three regressions were red before the fixes; Git Bash validation now passes npm test (307 passed, 0 failed, 3 platform skips), lint, coverage, and the persona gate. The gate remains NOT_CLEAN (3 PASS / 47 NEEDS_RUNTIME / 0 FAIL); issue #7's real runtime evidence and independent qualifying rounds remain outstanding.
